column3: Direct query of the license token (feature gate)
Any reference to the token model (superset of ET_CHECK, catches new usages)
Controller before_action feature guard (macro no longer included in ApplicationController -> NoMethodError at boot)
View helper that renders a banner and only YIELDS when the token allows the feature (silently hides content)
Contract validation based on token (module is neutralized centrally, still check new validators)
Contract errors that demand a plan
User/seat limit enforcement (OpenProject::Enterprise.user_limit is patched to 999999)
Menu/tab/custom-field-format/project-module metadata that marks an item as EE (consumers were removed)
Hard failure responses for missing token
Settings made read-only / inputs disabled because of EE
Direct use of the token gem (plans, features)
Calls to external trial / billing services
Static links used only for upsell
